app.name: Freezify
app.tagline: Know what you have, what expires and what you can cook.

households.title: My households
households.empty: You don't belong to any household yet. Create one or join with an invitation code.
households.inviteHelp: Generate a code and share it. Whoever enters it will join this household.
households.confirmLeave: Are you sure you want to leave “{{name}}”?
households.confirmDelete: “{{name}}” will be deleted for all its members. This cannot be undone. Continue?

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please check the information you entered.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account with that email already exists.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
errors.HOUSEHOLD_NOT_FOUND: This household doesn't exist or you no longer belong to it.
errors.NOT_HOUSEHOLD_OWNER: Only the household owner can do this.
errors.OWNER_CANNOT_LEAVE: The owner cannot leave the household. Delete it if you no longer need it.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: You already belong to this household.
errors.INVITATION_NOT_FOUND: The code is invalid or has expired.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: That person no longer belongs to the household.
errors.ITEM_NOT_FOUND: This food is no longer in the inventory.
errors.ITEM_NOT_ACTIVE: This food was already consumed or discarded.

errors.INCOMPATIBLE_UNIT: That unit is not compatible with the unit of the food.
errors.QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_AVAILABLE: There is less left than the quantity given.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.empty: No food yet. Add what you have at home to get started.
inventory.name: Food
inventory.invalidAmount: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
inventory.discardTitle: How much did you throw away?
